source: immutable public Git blobs; optional byte-matched frozen offline test evidence

scripts.release:check: bun run check && bun run lint:deps && bun run lint:boundaries && bun run lint:i18n && bun run test && bun run smoke

scripts.test:e2e: http_proxy= https_proxy= all_proxy= HTTP_PROXY= HTTPS_PROXY= ALL_PROXY= bun ./node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js test

scripts.test: bun run test:backend && bun run test:frontend
scripts.check: bun run check:backend && bun run check:frontend
scripts.lint:backend: bun run --cwd backend lint:deps && bun run --cwd backend lint:boundaries && bun run --cwd backend lint:i18n
scripts.lint: bun run lint:backend && bun run lint:frontend
